projects.title: SettleMyCar
projects.tagline: Automotive-services marketplace connecting car owners with vetted multi-brand workshops.
projects.summary: Co-founded and scaled an automotive repair and maintenance marketplace across Delhi-NCR, onboarding 50+ garage partners and fulfilling over 1,000+ consumer transactions.
projects.problem: The automotive repair ecosystem in urban centers was heavily fragmented: customers faced pricing asymmetry, opaque diagnostics, and uncertain turnaround times, while independent garages struggled with customer acquisition and capacity utilization.
projects.solution: Designed a centralized service marketplace with standardized pricing tiers, digital estimation workflows, and vehicle pickup/drop logistics to bridge trust between car owners and workshop operators.
projects.responsibilities: Managed workshop partner acquisition, contract negotiation, service pricing matrices, digital customer acquisition channels, and dispute resolution workflows.
projects.execution: Audited over 100+ local garages for tooling and technician capability, onboarded 50 qualified workshops, instituted milestone-based customer communication, and ran digital outbound funnels.
projects.outcomes: Achieved 1,000+ completed vehicle service transactions with strong customer satisfaction and established a repeatable unit-level operating playbook.
projects.learning: 0-to-1 marketplaces live or die by supply-side consistency. Standardizing operational quality at the ground level matters far more than software feature bloat.

projects.title: Dark Kitchen
projects.tagline: B2B food-supply venture serving commercial kitchens and restaurants with predictable supply chains.
projects.summary: Engineered an end-to-end B2B supply system for restaurants and cloud kitchens, managing daily farm-to-kitchen procurement, inventory forecasting, temperature-controlled delivery, and recurring supplier relationships.
projects.problem: Commercial kitchens suffer from volatile ingredient pricing, erratic early-morning vendor deliveries, and unpredictable quality defects that jeopardize daily restaurant service.
projects.solution: Built a reliable, recurring B2B supply pipeline combining bulk agricultural procurement, daily morning delivery SLA routes, and pre-negotiated wholesale pricing tiers.
projects.responsibilities: Handled wholesale mandi supplier procurement, restaurant client acquisition, daily logistics route scheduling, quality inspection, and working capital management.
projects.execution: Established direct wholesale farmer/mandi supply channels, set strict visual grading criteria, and built an automated order dispatch system guaranteeing delivery before 8:00 AM.
projects.outcomes: Maintained high client retention with recurring revenue and protected restaurants against sudden raw material inflation.
projects.learning: B2B customer retention is a byproduct of ruthless reliability. Eliminating operational anxiety for a business customer creates an enduring commercial moat.

hero.title: CareerOS: The AI-Powered Career Operating System
hero.subtitle: A continuous, profile-driven career operating system that shifts the integration burden away from the candidate and transforms job discovery into an automated intelligence engine.
hero.author: Vivek Dhoundiyal
hero.thesis: A person's career profile should become an active search engine for their career. The system should continuously evaluate opportunities against the user, rather than forcing the user to search through thousands of jobs.

infographic.heading: Your Career, Operated as a System.
infographic.intro: CareerOS brings fragmented career discovery, research, matching, tracking and application workflows into one connected operating system.
infographic.alt: CareerOS: Your All-in-One Career Operating System Workflow Overview
infographic.caption: Traditional job searching forces the candidate to become the integration layer between dozens of disconnected tools, job boards, spreadsheets, company pages and communication channels. CareerOS reverses that model. The profile becomes the system's intelligence layer, while discovery, verification, matching, organization and application tracking become connected workflows.

comparison.traditional: Manual browsing across LinkedIn, job boards & company portals
comparison.careeros: Automated multi-source registry continuously indexing targeted companies

comparison.traditional: Keyword guessing resulting in high false positives
comparison.careeros: 7-dimensional profile-aware AI evaluation with explainable reasoning

comparison.traditional: Stale 30-60 day listings resurfaced as new discovery events
comparison.careeros: Strict 7-day posting date SLA; unverified listings purged automatically

comparison.traditional: Fragmented spreadsheets, lost notes & disjointed email alerts
comparison.careeros: Unified career command center with deterministic state-machine pipeline

transition.heading: Inside CareerOS
transition.lead: The operating-system view explains the product at a high level. The architecture below shows how that idea becomes a real product system.
transition.body: The following architecture sections present the core system models, forensic failure-mode analyses, domain normalization schemas, query engines, and engineering standards formulated during system discovery. Each chapter illustrates a foundational layer of the end-to-end product architecture.

architecturePages.title: CareerOs: The AI-Powered Career Operating System
architecturePages.transition: The case study begins with the fundamental inversion of how professionals discover and evaluate opportunities.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The foundational thesis of CareerOS: inverting the traditional job search model. Instead of an individual manually scanning through thousands of disconnected, unverified job listings, the candidate profile acts as a continuously running query engine that pulls, parses, and evaluates opportunities against structured candidate criteria.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Manual job searching incurs massive cognitive fatigue, context switching, and high search friction. Treating the profile as an active search engine converts career discovery from a reactive, intermittent chore into an automated, systematic background service.
architecturePages.productThinking: Inverting user agency: the system brings verified opportunities to the candidate rather than requiring the candidate to repeatedly query fragmented job boards.

architecturePages.title: Shifting the Integration Burden Away from the User
architecturePages.alt: User as Integration Layer vs Profile as Integration Layer
architecturePages.transition: To understand why CareerOS exists, we first must inspect where modern job searching breaks down at the human level.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The contrast between the status-quo fragmented search model—where the candidate is forced to act as the human integration glue connecting LinkedIn, ATS portals, spreadsheets, emails, Notion, and company portals—versus the CareerOS integrated model where the profile orchestrates discovery, filtering, matching, decisions, application, and tracking.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: When the candidate is the integration layer, context switching between tools degrades decision quality, increases latency, and causes high drop-off rates in application pipelines.
architecturePages.productThinking: System integration is the core product value proposition. CareerOS is not just another job aggregator; it is an operating layer that abstracts away multi-platform friction into a cohesive stateful pipeline.

architecturePages.title: Evolving from Temporary Job Cards to a Persistent Intelligence System
architecturePages.alt: Evolution from Ephemeral Job Cards to Persistent Intelligence System
architecturePages.transition: Moving past initial discovery requires defining what kind of software artifact CareerOS actually is.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The structural shift from ephemeral UI widgets to a persistent intelligence system. While traditional boards discard listings once clicked, CareerOS maintains an immutable, versioned domain graph connecting candidate profile vectors, normalized job specs, application history, and historical outcomes.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Career trajectories span months and years, not single search sessions. An ephemeral UI prevents long-term feedback loops, predictive matching improvements, and cumulative market intelligence.
architecturePages.productThinking: Long-term product moat comes from persistent state and continuous learning, transforming a transactional search session into an enduring professional asset.

architecturePages.title: Feature Accumulation Led to Architectural Fragmentation
architecturePages.alt: Forensic System Decomposition of Feature Creep
architecturePages.transition: A forensic audit of early prototype iterations revealed critical structural failure modes.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: A forensic decomposition of early prototype failure modes. Rapid feature additions (custom scrapers, reactive filters, un-indexed tags, ad-hoc alerting) without canonical domain schemas created race conditions, duplicate listings, corrupted state transitions, and degraded query performance.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Uncontrolled feature velocity without domain boundaries creates compounding architectural fragility, crippling user trust when jobs show incorrect status or outdated requirements.
architecturePages.productThinking: Rigorous root-cause analysis is senior PM hygiene. Acknowledging architectural debt early is essential to building high-integrity platforms that scale.

architecturePages.title: The Solution is Not Another Collection of UI Fixes
architecturePages.alt: Root Cause Diagnosis Across Ingestion, Domain, Logic, and Pipeline
architecturePages.transition: Diagnosing the root causes showed that superficial visual polish could not solve underlying data fragmentation.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: Categorization of system breakdowns across four core tiers: Ingestion Fragmentation (unvalidated data ingestion), Domain Ambiguity (loose entity boundaries), Logic Collisions (competing filter heuristics), and Pipeline Mutation (inconsistent stage progression).
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Treating structural ingestion and domain failures with cosmetic surface-level changes leaves data inaccuracies and pipeline drop-offs unresolved.
architecturePages.productThinking: Product managers must address the root systemic causes rather than masking architectural flaws behind polished UI facades.

architecturePages.title: Normalizing the Domain: Canonical Filter Logic
architecturePages.alt: Canonical Filter Logic Rules: Disjunctive Within, Conjunctive Across
architecturePages.transition: To eliminate search ambiguities, we formalized the foundational query engine rules.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: Formal specification of the CareerOS query algebra: Disjunctive (OR) evaluation within categorical dimensions (e.g. Remote OR Hybrid), combined with Conjunctive (AND) evaluation across orthogonal dimensions (Role AND Seniority AND Compensation AND Location).
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Ambiguous boolean evaluation is the primary driver of search irrelevance on traditional platforms, returning false positives that waste valuable candidate review time.
architecturePages.productThinking: Deterministic query behavior builds deep user confidence. The candidate must always understand exactly why a specific opportunity was matched or excluded.

architecturePages.title: Defining Canonical Entities for Roles and Remote Work
architecturePages.transition: With query algebra established, incoming unstandardized job metadata required strict entity normalization.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The multi-tiered normalization framework that maps raw text inputs from hundreds of ATS platforms into canonical domain models (e.g., mapping "Staff PM", "Lead Product Owner", "Group PM" into standardized role archetypes and location bands).
architecturePages.whyItMatters: ATS nomenclature varies wildly across companies. Without normalization, candidates miss critical opportunities simply due to divergent naming conventions.
architecturePages.productThinking: Taxonomy is core product infrastructure. Normalizing disparate terminology enables accurate cross-platform comparisons and automated matchmaking.

architecturePages.title: Enforcing a Strict Freshness Mandate and Live Verification
architecturePages.alt: Strict Freshness Mandate and Real-Time Verification Specification
architecturePages.transition: Beyond taxonomy, stale data undermines trust, necessitating a strict operational freshness mandate.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The strict operational SLA: listings older than 7 days from first verification are flagged for re-validation; unverified postings are purged. Real-time monitoring tracks service latency, extraction health, and URL dead-link rates.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Ghost jobs and zombie listings on legacy job boards consume candidate energy on opportunities that have already closed or been filled weeks prior.
architecturePages.productThinking: Freshness is an uncompromisable product contract. A smaller, verified catalog of active opportunities creates far higher utility than millions of stale records.

architecturePages.title: The Core PM Trade-off: Quality Over Volume
architecturePages.alt: Core PM Strategic Tradeoff Matrix: Quality vs Volume
architecturePages.transition: Enforcing strict freshness and normalization required making an explicit strategic trade-off.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The foundational product trade-off matrix: deliberately rejecting aggregate volume metrics in favor of high-signal precision, data completeness, verified posting dates, and low noise.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Vanity metrics prioritize displaying tens of thousands of low-quality jobs. For candidates, noise creates decision paralysis and wasted effort.
architecturePages.productThinking: High-conviction product positioning: CareerOS is engineered for the candidate seeking 10 exceptional, verified matches rather than 500 dubious listings.

architecturePages.title: The Rebuilt Architecture: A Single, Consolidated Pipeline
architecturePages.transition: With strategic trade-offs defined, we engineered the consolidated end-to-end processing pipeline.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The unified operational workflow: Raw multi-source ingestion → Canonical entity normalization → Freshness validation engine → Profile semantic matching → Active application tracking.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: A single, observable pipeline prevents split-brain state, eliminates race conditions, and guarantees consistent data flow from external job boards into candidate tracking.
architecturePages.productThinking: Clean architecture enables sustainable iteration. Consolidating fragmented micro-scripts into a unified pipeline dramatically lowers maintenance overhead.

architecturePages.title: Moving Beyond Keywords: The Matching Engine Paradigm
architecturePages.transition: With clean data flowing through the pipeline, we rebuilt the core intelligence: the 7-dimensional matching engine.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The multi-dimensional matching engine evaluating 7 orthogonal vectors: Domain Skills, Scope & Seniority, Strategic Alignment, Working Modality, Cultural Attributes, Compensation Bracket, and Growth Trajectory.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Naive keyword searches match irrelevant jobs containing identical words while missing deeply relevant roles with slightly different titles.
architecturePages.productThinking: Explainable AI over black-box scoring: every match score provides candidate-visible rationale detailing exact strengths and potential gaps.

architecturePages.title: UX Direction: High Information Density, Low Cognitive Load
architecturePages.alt: High Information Density Interface Layout Specification
architecturePages.transition: Complex multi-dimensional matching required an interface optimized for cognitive clarity.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The UX specification prioritizing high information density with low cognitive load: modular job cards, instant dimensional match indicators, expandable audit criteria, and keyboard-first workflow navigation.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Poor UX forces users to open dozens of browser tabs to evaluate basic requirements. High-density interfaces enable rapid, confident decision-making.
architecturePages.productThinking: Productivity tool design philosophy: respectful of candidate attention, minimizing unnecessary clicks, and presenting high-context signals upfront.

architecturePages.title: Redefining the Definition of Done (DoD)
architecturePages.alt: Definition of Done (DoD) Engineering Governance Framework
architecturePages.transition: To sustain system integrity, engineering releases must adhere to a strict Definition of Done.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: Product governance framework mandating that every released feature passes data validation, automated freshness verification, rigorous quality checks, and end-to-end workflow integration before release.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Without rigorous release gates, edge cases in web extraction and data parsing quickly corrupt downstream candidate tracking states.
architecturePages.productThinking: Operational discipline as product strategy. Reliability is a non-negotiable feature that compounds user trust over time.

architecturePages.title: Execution Roadmap: Prioritizing System Stability Over New Features
architecturePages.transition: Governed by this standard, the implementation roadmap phases technical stability ahead of feature expansion.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: The phased execution roadmap prioritizing core architecture, data integrity, and matching precision in Phase 1 before expanding to advanced automation, interview copilots, and multi-tenant capabilities in Phase 2 & 3.
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Premature feature expansion on unstable foundations leads to technical collapse. Solidifying core domain mechanics ensures future capabilities scale effortlessly.
architecturePages.productThinking: Sequencing is the essence of product leadership: knowing what not to build yet is as important as knowing what to build first.

architecturePages.title: The Ultimate PM Synthesis
architecturePages.alt: Executive PM Synthesis and Four-Stage Architectural Maturity Model
architecturePages.transition: The case study concludes with an executive synthesis of the systems architecture and product trajectory.
architecturePages.whatThisLayerRepresents: Executive synthesis uniting the four pillars of CareerOS: Systems Thinking (holistic lifecycle), Rigorous Prioritization (quality over volume), Transparent Engineering (zero vanity metrics), and Architectural Longevity (persistent data).
architecturePages.whyItMatters: Demonstrates end-to-end product mastery: bridging strategic market vision, domain architecture, algorithmic matching, and technical execution into a coherent product asset.
architecturePages.productThinking: True product leadership balances vision with architectural rigor. CareerOS proves how systems thinking transforms broken, fragmented experiences into elegant, high-impact software.

steps.name: Explainable Match Scoring

steps.name: Closed-Loop Feedback Loop

productThinking.heading: Product Thinking Behind CareerOS
productThinking.intro: Five architectural and product management principles that guide every decision within CareerOS.

principles.title: Shifting the Integration Burden
principles.concept: The candidate should never be the human glue between job boards, ATS portals, spreadsheets, and emails. The software must absorb the complexity of integration, aggregation, and tracking.

principles.title: Profile as an Active Search Engine
principles.concept: Instead of forcing candidates to query thousands of noisy listings repeatedly, candidate credentials, preferences, and trajectory act as an autonomous engine pulling and scoring incoming opportunities.

principles.title: Signal Over Volume
principles.concept: Presenting 10 high-confidence, verified opportunities with explainable fit is infinitely more valuable than overwhelming the user with 500 unvalidated, stale, or sponsored job cards.

principles.title: Deterministic State Over Ephemeral UI
principles.concept: Career progression is an enduring multi-month workflow. Ephemeral UI states create data loss and friction; persistent state machines with strict SLAs maintain pipeline momentum.

principles.title: Explainable AI Over Black-Box Magic
principles.concept: High-stakes career decisions require absolute transparency. Every algorithmic recommendation must expose the exact criteria, data points, and trade-offs that produced the match score.

whyIBuilt.heading: Why I Built CareerOS
narrative: Traditional job searching is broken by design. Candidates are forced to juggle dozens of job boards, company career portals, messy spreadsheets, fragmented email alerts, and separate note-taking apps. The candidate is turned into the human integration layer.

The product thesis behind CareerOS is simple: treat the career search itself as an operating system rather than a collection of disconnected tasks. The goal is not simply to show more jobs, but to build a connected system that helps a professional discover high-signal opportunities, evaluate true mutual alignment, decide with clarity, execute targeted applications, and learn from market outcomes.
CareerOS represents the convergence of systems thinking, data normalization, and applied AI workflows—engineered to restore agency and clarity to professional progression.
